title: acer laurinum subsp. decandrum
intro: Acer laurinum subsp. decandrum, commonly known as the Laurel Maple, is a subspecies of the Acer laurinum tree, native to the eastern Mediterranean region. The Laurel Maple is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. Therapeutically, it is believed to have actions such as vasodilation, diuretic effects, and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents present in the Laurel Maple include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
